name: Tuvan People's Republic (Tannu Tuva, 1943–1944)
description: A red field with the yellow Cyrillic initials 'ТАР' in the upper hoist.
history: The last flag of the Tuvan People's Republic, adopted on 8 September 1943 when Tuvan switched to the Cyrillic alphabet and the Latin initials on the previous flag were replaced. It was abolished when Tuva was absorbed into the Soviet Union on 11 October 1944.
